SASBDB entry SASDBS6  (https://www.sasbdb.org/data/SASDBS6/)

Publication: Structural and biochemical analysis of Escherichia coli ObgE, a central regulator of bacterial persistence
DOI:         https://doi.org/10.1074/jbc.M116.761809

The publisher's PDF used to be kept in this folder. It was removed from the repository
(size, and the publisher's redistribution terms): fetch it from the DOI above. The
fitting script test/fitting_tests/SASDBS6/ cites the sections and tables it takes the
buffer and sample conditions from.
